title: Taking Back
paragraphs: “Because that staff was used in the ritual, it was able to generate such a powerful force field. That must be the reason.”

What!? Are you saying that is the Seven Star Staff that Trash once possessed? Well, since I took Trash down, the staff must have been flung somewhere. Still, to think it was used in a ritual that turned Melromarc into a state of demonic occupation—what a surprise. Ah, so by infusing the staff with the power of brainwashing, it led to this situation.
“Is that thing also a Hero?”
“Really? No way would a Seven Star Weapon lend its power to something like that!”
“W-W-Wah!”
Rival, Assistant, and Mole each voiced their reactions to the sight before them.
“Either way, we simply need to brush aside the sparks that fall upon us.”
Yuki-chan and the Filolials understand the situation well. On the other hand, the Queen, Fiancée, and Éclair are slow to respond to the crisis.
“To think that Aultcray’s staff would be responsible for such a disaster…”
“Mother, get a hold of yourself!”
“Queen! Guh… I will not allow that staff to bring ruin to this nation!”
Father and the others are heightening their vigilance. Honestly, getting carried away just because of a staff is quite bothersome.
“If the power that resided in the Pope and the King’s body double has converged, that means the strength of the people of this country has been gathered into one place.”
“Yeah, I can feel an even more ominous force than before…”
“It feels like something straight out of a game, but when it happens for real, it’s beyond frustrating.”
This is a hassle. Should I just take it down immediately? Almost at the same moment I channel power into my spear— The red-black pig moves.
“Bububu! Bububu!”

The red-black pig brandishes its staff and begins chanting magic. At the same time, it unleashes a barrage of skills. …The sheer number is overwhelming. It’s as if dozens of people simultaneously cast magic and skills against us.
“Whoa! Air Strike Shield X! Second Shield X! Air One-Way Shield V! Second One-Way Shield V! Damn… not enough shields!”

The barrage of magic and skills cast by the red-black pig obliterates the throne room, blowing away the upper half of the castle. Oh… is this the result of gathering the power of the people in Melromarc’s capital? Well, this level of destruction isn’t impossible for me either if I cast magic seriously. As debris, magic, and skills rain down, Father conjures shields to protect everyone. I deflect the incoming magic and skills with my windmill.
“No choice! Crescent Moon Shield V!”

Father cast a weak area defense skill. Then, a Meteor Shield barrier appeared only in front of Father. The range gradually expanded. The magic flying toward Father struck the barrier, and—just as it gave off a bright shimmer—it was reflected back.
“Buhii!?”
The red-black pig was hit by the reflected magic and staggered slightly.
“Magic reflection!?”
“That effect is more useful than I expected.”
“The fact that the range expands gradually is convenient too, isn’t it?”
“It’s tricky to use… but not bad.”
“Bubububu!”
The red-black pig, enraged by the pain, stomped its feet furiously.
“Shut up! Just die already! Brionac X!”

I channeled all my power into Brionac and launched it at the red-black pig. This will be the second time I’ve killed the wielder of that staff! HAHAHA, no matter how many times you come back, I’ll slaughter you again!
“Buhihihihi!”
Just when I thought I had burned it to ashes, the red-black pig reappeared a few meters away from Brionac’s trajectory.
“What’s this? Do you think dodging that little attack means you’ve won?”
As I spoke, the red-black pig’s shadow expanded and started multiplying. What an eyesore. It would be best to take care of them quickly and send them off to the slaughterhouse.
“T-This is…!”
“Clones? One of them must be the real one… right?”

The swarm of red-black pigs pointed their staffs at us and unleashed another barrage of skills and magic. Could they have mixed ritual magic into this as well? Father’s Crescent Moon Shield expanded into a Half-Moon Shield.
“Everyone!”
“Understood!”
Responding to Father’s voice, everyone used him as a shield to evade the downpour of magic and skills.
“We just have to wait for this storm to pass before counterattacking…”

Boom! Boom! The relentless barrage of magic and skills continued to rain down. Father’s skill had impressive durability, but it looked like it was gradually wearing down. At this rate, it might break soon.
“Gaelion will unleash his breath attack!”
“Alright, Imiya-chan, help him out too.”
“Yes!”
The rivals chanted magic and unleashed breath attacks. However, that only stopped the rain of skills and magic in one small area. It was immediately replenished.
“Ahh… In RPGs, there should be cooldowns, and our skills should have them too, but it’s firing continuously.”
“It’s probably not a special ability of the staff. More likely, it’s using sheer numbers to maintain a never-ending barrage of attacks.”
“And nearly limitless power is being supplied from the castle town… no, from the entire country. On top of that, it’s being treated as a Hero ability-wise…”
“No… it’s not limitless. If this continues, the people of the country will start dying by the second!”
This is beyond troublesome.
“If they’re clones, then the real one must be somewhere. If we can take it down, we might be able to do something.”
“Itsuki, do you have any good ideas?”
“Thanks to my weapon changing into guns, I do have a certain area skill, but…”
Inside Father’s barrier, which had already expanded into a full moon, Itsuki aimed his dual guns and activated a skill.
“Desperal X!”
Itsuki’s bullets struck the foreheads of the surrounding red-black pigs. However, the sheer number was overwhelming. Just as soon as they were shot down, another wave of skills rained down on us.
“…Each shot is a deadly skill, but where is the real one?”
“Then I’ll cast a spell. Liberation Fire Floor X!”
Might as well wipe out all the red-black pigs in the area.
“Bubububu!”

Oh? The magic I cast was weakened by the interference spells of the countless red-black pigs. Even so, I still managed to obliterate all the ones within the designated range. But more red-black pigs immediately sprouted from the ground.
“Motoyasu-kun, please don’t provoke them too much. We can probably whittle them down, but if we do, Melromarc will just become a land of the dead!”
“This is beyond annoying.”
“No… Motoyasu, can’t you strip the staff away like you did with Takt? That alone might secure our victory.”
“Understood!”
Last time, I tried the same thing on Trash, but the staff refused to respond… Still, it’s worth the gamble.
“The Love Hunter commands you. Vassal weapon, heed the call of the Love Hunter and leave the unworthy wielder!” I declared toward the staff held by the red-black pig.
At that moment, the staff glowed faintly in response.
“Buhii!?”
“—I revoke your qualification as a vassal wielder!”
At my declaration, the staff floated up and attempted to fly away. As expected, just like with Takt, it wasn’t chosen through the proper means. However—
“Eh?”
“What!?”
“T-That is…?”
A black aura extended from the red-black pig’s hand and pulled the fleeing staff back.
“Buhihihihi, buhi, buhibuhi!”
“Tch… It actually forced the staff back through brute strength!?”
This is absurd. The idea that its control over the weapon is stronger than Takt’s is beyond ridiculous.
“But this confirms it—it’s controlling the staff through some kind of illegal, demonic power. If we can take it away, we have a chance to win.”
“We can’t afford to weaken its power for the sake of the country. We have to take down the real one in a single strike… Is that even possible?”
At Itsuki’s words, Father nodded while breaking into a nervous sweat.
